title: Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call. | TechCrunch
summary: Parents can usually manage these devices through a companion app, allowing them to approve contacts, monitor locations, set screen time limits, select available apps, and, in some cases, receive alerts regarding cyberbullying, explicit content, or online predators.
